title: An unreadable transcript refuses, because unknown is never the favorable value
rationale: recentlyEdited() returns true when it cannot measure, and the gate has no vocabulary for "unknown". A corpus of static directories has no transcript, so this is the trap that makes a first harness run report total refusal — it is pinned here rather than rediscovered.
